# Vubbs

> Chat-powered video editing. Describe your edit in plain language — Vubbs clips, captions, and formats your footage instantly. No timeline dragging, no tutorials.

## What Vubbs does

Vubbs is an AI video editing platform where users describe what they want in plain text, and the system produces a clipped, captioned, and formatted video ready to post. The interface is conversational — users type natural language commands like "clip the best 45 seconds, add bold captions, make it vertical" and receive the output.

## Core features

- Smart video clipping: AI identifies the best moments or follows user-specified timestamps
- Word-synced auto captions: Captions are anchored to the actual spoken word, not approximated
- Chat-to-edit interface: All editing happens through a conversation, not a timeline
- Format conversion: Vertical 9:16 reframing for Instagram and TikTok
- Caption style templates: Bold, minimal, colored, and custom styles

## Proof

Built by the team behind short-form video content that has generated 10M+ views across Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube.
